cause_quote: The introducing diff added `phase?.mark("preparation");` inside `onSessionPrepared` and added `diagnostics.finish();` in `onAgentRunStart` and after dispatch settled, so a prepared reply that skipped the startup callback stayed in the preparation phase.
user_saw: The Gateway acknowledged a steer send in 51 ms, then logged about 476 seconds of preparation when most of that time was spent running an agent turn.
summary: The fix attributes prepared-reply time to a separate `run` phase in slow chat-send logs and structured diagnostics.
reasoning: The commit that introduced the timing already awaited prepared replies and had a steering path that could await an existing run without firing a new-run callback. The later steering diagnostics commit changed the report's stage label while preserving the phase accounting. The original code shows how steering time could be charged to preparation, though the exact production sequence could not be confirmed at that revision.
